1.note: Terse phrase; read as the adherents fixing their hopes on the new sect.

2.note: א. ג. = Apostelgeschichte (Acts). The verse on sitting at Gamaliel's feet is Acts 22:3; kept as printed.

3.note: The Mishnah on cancelling the bill before the agent is at Gittin 32a; kept as printed.

4.note: The gentile poor and gleanings are in Gittin 59b/61a; page reference kept as printed.

5.note: א. ג. = Acts; the complaint about the daily distribution is Acts 6:1. Kept as printed.

6.note: Printed so; the usual text of the letter has קטינין, 'small'.

7.note: Printed so; the story of Abba Yose ben Ḥanan (Yoḥanan) against the high-priestly houses is in Pesaḥim 57a.

8.note: Printed so; Abba Saul ben Batnit's strictness is in Mishnah Beitzah 3:8.

9.note: Printed so; Ḥanan's two rulings are in Mishnah Ketubbot 13:1–2 (the second is cited as פי"ג מ"ב).

10.note: Printed so; Zechariah ben ha-Katzav's testimony is in Eduyot 8:2.

11.note: Printed so; Zechariah ben ha-Katzav's midrash on the letter is in Mishnah Sotah 5:1.

12.note: Abbreviation as printed; possibly R. Joshua ben Bava or R. Judah ben Bava.

13.note: The print is damaged here (the OCR read סוף שי יות); the reading 'Eduyot' fits the Tosefta passage on the title Rabban.

14.note: Printed so (resh for lamed); the story of the death of Rabban Simeon ben Gamaliel is in Avot de-Rabbi Natan ch. 38.

15.note: The print is unclear and may read פ"ד; R. Ḥanina's testimony on the hides is in Zevaḥim 12:4.

16.note: The print is blurred and looks like וחנה הנך; read והנה הנך. The quotation continues the Maimonides citation (דה"מ 142) in the body.
